name: Vertex Search
instructions: Lessons do not store their parent course; derive it with *[_type == "course" && references(^._id)][0]. Module and lesson numbers are positional from modules[] and modules[].lessons[] order, never stored. notes is Portable Text; search its plain text with pt::text(notes). Text match is token-based: wildcard individual keywords and OR the patterns; never match a whole phrase as one pattern. duration is seconds. Video documents are internal lookups, never results by themselves; join them to lessons by video URL. Match chapter labels first and inspect transcript chunks only when no chapter matches. Filter matching chapters/chunks and return only a few matches; never project whole transcript or timeline arrays. If there are no video documents, return lesson matches only. Never invent a lesson, course, count, timestamp, or result.
